body: A distributed framework for reinforcement learning and preference tuning of large language models.
plain_description: **Train and refine language models with reinforcement learning from human feedback.** Run supervised fine-tuning, preference learning, reward-model training, and RL workflows with built-in algorithms and custom rewards. Scale training across GPUs and nodes.
technical_description: OpenRLHF is a Python framework for RLHF and agent-based reinforcement learning. It supports supervised fine-tuning, DPO/IPO/cDPO, reward-model training, and PPO, REINFORCE++, GRPO, RLOO, and related algorithms. It uses Ray for distributed scheduling, vLLM for generation, DeepSpeed for training, and Hugging Face Transformers for model loading and fine-tuning. Supports single- and multi-turn agents, custom rewards, LoRA/QLoRA, and multimodal VLM training.
title: OpenRLHF
